leadText:
Mandarin Island North (Japanese: キンカン島 Kinkan Island) is one of the Orange Islands. It is a large city with tall skyscrapers and buildings, which Jessie referred to as The Big Orange, an allusion to New York City (The Big Apple). It was featured in the episode Pikachu Re-Volts.

Butch and Cassidy once used Mandarin Island North for one of their schemes. Using a , they hypnotized all the Pokémon on the island into turning against their Trainers. This included Ash's Pikachu, Misty's Togepi, and .
plainText:
Mandarin Island North (Japanese: キンカン島 Kinkan Island) is one of the Orange Islands. It is a large city with tall skyscrapers and buildings, which Jessie referred to as The Big Orange, an allusion to New York City (The Big Apple). It was featured in the episode Pikachu Re-Volts.

Butch and Cassidy once used Mandarin Island North for one of their schemes. Using a , they hypnotized all the Pokémon on the island into turning against their Trainers. This included Ash's Pikachu, Misty's Togepi, and .

==Places of interest==
===Police Station===
A place in the city where Officer Jenny patrols the streets of Mandarin Island. It is a large building that has a tower and two rooms on either side of the tower. Above the doorway, there is a large star. Inside is a large sitting area with a desk, computer, telephone, and a couple of Wanted posters.

===Team Rocket's hideout===
On the side of the city, there is a large, abandoned power plant that was used as Butch and Cassidy's hideout when they were using to all the Pokémon on the island. The hypnotized Pokémon got in the power plant through an air duct on the side of the entrance gate. The building has since been reduced rubble due to 's use of via , however.

==Trivia==
Although this island shares the name with Mandarin Island South, there is very little in common. It is believed the islands are named the same because of a dubbing error. In Japan, their names are not the same.
